tasks.question: Attackers are running obfuscated PowerShell scripts on our servers and we cannot see what the scripts actually do. What should we turn on first?
tasks.notes: Visibility into script content is the gap; script-block logging closes it.

tasks.question: We suspect someone used a tool like Mimikatz to dump credentials from LSASS memory on a domain controller. How should we catch this next time?
tasks.notes: Credential dumping from LSASS (T1003.001); detection is alerting on LSASS reads.

tasks.question: Users keep receiving Word documents whose macros start cmd.exe when opened. How do we stop these documents from launching programs?
tasks.notes: Office spawning child processes is exactly what the attack-surface rule blocks.

tasks.question: How should we respond to CVE-2021-44228 on our internet-facing Java web servers?
tasks.notes: Log4Shell on an exposed service: patch or take it offline.

tasks.question: A local user on our Linux build server could become root through CVE-2021-4034. What is the right fix?
tasks.notes: PwnKit is a local privilege escalation; the fix is the OS patch.
